description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clever Impersonator dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Clever Impersonator enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Clever Impersonator from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
